title: Volcanoes of the Americas (hot and cold)
intro: 10 volcanoes of the Americas, one after another. You have three tries for each place and are told warmer or colder after a miss. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Trindade
rounds.fact: Trindade is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 5 m in the source data. The data places it in Brazil.

rounds.name: Mount Akutan

rounds.name: Hualalai

rounds.name: Huaynaputina
